claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is April 9–12.
Television coverage of the first two rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament is primarily on ESPN.
Television coverage of the weekend rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament is primarily on CBS.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Paramount+, ESPN+, and Masters.com.
The Par 3 contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Wednesday.
Featured groups for the 2026 Masters Tournament run all day.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs Thursday, April 9 from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs Friday, April 10 from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs Saturday, April 11 from 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
The final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs Sunday, April 12 from 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
The Par 3 Contest airs April 8 from Noon–2 p.m. ET on ESPN App/Disney+.
The Par 3 Contest airs April 8 from 2–4 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Early round coverage for Thursday and Friday of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 1–3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.
Weekend early coverage for Saturday and Sunday of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 12–2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Featured Groups and Holes have daily coverage for the 2026 Masters Tournament via Masters App and ESPN+.
Featured Groups and Holes coverage for the 2026 Masters Tournament includes Amen Corner, Holes 4, 5, 6, 15, 16.
Sky Sports Golf offers live coverage of all four days of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Sky Sports Golf offers live coverage of the Par 3 contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Sky Sports Golf offers featured group action for the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m. ET.
ESPN Deportes covers the first and second rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 3–7:30 p.m. ET.
ESPN Deportes covers the third and final rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 5–6 p.m. ET.
All times for the 2026 Masters Tournament coverage are in Eastern Time (ET).
